headline: B200 marketplace rates drop -10% in a week while headline GPU indexes hold mostly flat.
bullets: B200's market index slipped -1% to $8.41, driven by the marketplace median falling -10% to $7.20, while hyperscaler ($14.12) and neocloud ($7.99) held at +0%.
A100 80GB SXM's index was unchanged at $2.70 (+0%), but its marketplace median rose +7% to $1.36, with Vast.ai cheapest at $1.33.
H100 PCIe offers the best price-performance of the 11 tracked GPUs at $3.60 per PFLOP-hour; among headline GPUs, MI300X ($3.62) and B200 ($3.74) are closest.
H100 NVL carries the widest hyperscaler premium at +184%; among headline GPUs, H100 SXM leads at +140% ($10.68 hyperscaler vs $4.45 neocloud).
H200 held at $5.40 (+0%) with hyperscaler and neocloud segments unchanged at +0%, and RunPod Community Cloud was the cheapest provider at $3.59.
watch: Whether the -10% drop in the B200 marketplace median spreads to the neocloud segment, currently $7.99.
